html:
What Is a Complete Home Redesign?

Every room is handled as one project, by one team and under one contract. A unified design language connects the palette, materials, lighting and built details across the home.

It is more considered and efficient than commissioning rooms separately. Work can be phased room by room, so clients can often remain at home while each area is completed.

The redesign covers the built space. Furniture-inclusive options are also available by contacting Woodex.

One briefShared priorities across every room
One languageMaterials and light that belong together
One contractClear scope and accountability

What We Deliver

Eight coordinated layers turn separate rooms into one complete home plan.

Scroll the scope ledger

01

Unified Design Concept

One palette, colour scheme and lighting style gives every room a clear relationship to the next.

02

Kitchen + Bathrooms

Kitchen and bathroom cabinetry, surfaces, fixtures and plumbing are planned within the wider home.

03

Bedrooms + Living

Wardrobes, flooring, headboard walls, feature walls and the media unit are coordinated around daily life.

04

Flooring + Lighting Throughout

Transitions, light levels and fixture families are resolved consistently from room to room.

05

Room-by-Room Phasing

A practical sequence helps contain disruption and can allow the family to remain at home.

06

3D Visualization of Key Spaces

Important rooms are shown clearly before materials are ordered and work begins.

07

Phased Cost Planning

An itemised fixed-price agreement by room makes each stage and its budget easier to control.

08

Quality Warranty

A 2-year warranty covers construction, fixtures and finishes within the agreed execution scope.

Our Design Process

The home is resolved in one sequence, with decisions made before they reach site.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We understand your rooms, routines, priorities, budget and preferred pace.

02

Site Measurement

Every room, opening, service and retained element is recorded accurately.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Layouts and a shared visual direction establish how the complete home works.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

Finishes, fixtures and furniture are coordinated across connected spaces.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

Drawings, specifications and key 3D views prepare the project for execution.

Typical design timelineTypically 2-3 weeks from whole-home survey to final design package. Larger homes take longer.

Start with a free whole-home survey and consultation. Design fees typically range from PKR 50,000-150,000+.
